card.name: Review verbs before qualities of a work
card.fires_on: Words right after a book, music or play reviewer's subject, where a verb like emphasizes or conveys could come next (e.g. 'prose captures', 'music conveys', 'uses simple words to great effect').

modes.label: Verb after the work
modes.description: A verb such as captures or conveys follows an author, prose or music in a review.
modes.example: Hall's prose<< captures>> the wide-eyed simplicity of the very young

modes.label: Linking words in praise
modes.description: A small word like because, and, to or every sits where the review is about to say what the work stresses or achieves.
modes.example: Tim O'Brien uses simple words and phrases<< to>> great effect.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward emphasize/emphasis-type words that say what a work highlights.
card.plain: It fires in book or music reviews where the next word could be 'emphasizes' or 'highlights' something about the work.
